Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced a flawed methodology by instructing the team to infer birthplace from “origin/hometown/based-in” fields and even to treat mentions of København/Copenhagen (e.g., origin, base, residence) as confirming birthplace. This conflates residence/origin with birthplace and could lead to an incorrect answer. While the final conclusion was still correct, this was the first clear procedural error.
